Where would you like to begin?

Six ways into the life of the parish. None of them asks you to know anything first.

Gather together Coffee hour every Sunday, and — proposed — a full parish meal once a month. Care for one another Cook a meal for a family who needs one — or ask for one yourself. Serve the parish Greeting, setting up, the children's corner, events, outreach. Prepare & beautify the church Flowers, greenery, and the work behind a feast day. Make an offering Prosphora, wine, oil and flowers used in the worship of the Church. Learn the traditions Come and be taught. Then, one day, teach someone else.

However much time you have
